ella: Partner (EdgeWave) opened a billing dispute: ~3.2k units for May	6Jul not reflected on invoices. can we triage?
priya: on it. can they share sample event ids or CSV?
ella: they attached csv and one sample id: ew-evt-20250630-a1b2. partner timestamp 1712083200.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace export generated: s3://marketplace-exports/edgewave/2025-07/usage_export_20250731.json
derek: likely causes: sku mapping mismatch or our hourly windowing. i'll run a quick dry-run replay in staging.
priya: plan: 1) compare partner CSV -> marketplace export counts 2) join export -> raw_ingest to find missing ids 3) tag reasons (sku_mismatch/window_drop/filtered)
nana: legal (ana): flag contract clause re: backdated credits (90-day cap). if events older than that partner needs device evidence.
priya: pulling export now. will post unmatched CSV link when ready.
marketplace-bot: Recon job: partner rows 3,200; matched 2,820; unmatched 380. report: https://internal.apps/recon/edgewave/3311122334
derek: dry-run shows ~370 records would be accepted after remapping. uploaded diff: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/replay-diff-3311122334.json
priya: unmatched CSV: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/unmatched-3311122334.csv (380 rows). majority labeled sku_mismatch.
nana: legal: will confirm whether partner-provided evidence covers >90 days.
ella: i'll notify partner that we're investigating and may need device delivery logs for older events.
priya: action items: priya -> finalize CSV and root-cause table; derek -> hold production replay until approvals; ana -> advise on credit eligibility; ella -> partner comms. ETA EOD.
